description: Defines the HierarchyChartMobile class for rendering and managing a hierarchical chart with interactive nodes and connectors, including methods for hierarchy setup, node expansion/collapse, and SVG connector management.

classes.name: erpnext.HierarchyChartMobile
classes.description: Class for creating and managing an interactive hierarchy chart with nodes and connectors in a mobile view.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the hierarchy chart with doctype, wrapper, and method options, setting up the DOM and node class.

methods.name: setup_node_class
methods.description: Defines the Node class used for individual nodes in the hierarchy.

methods.name: make_node_element
methods.description: Creates the DOM element for a node using a template and appends it to the parent.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the hierarchy chart, including company selection and SVG marker setup.

methods.name: make_svg_markers
methods.description: Prepares SVG markers for connector arrows.

methods.name: setup_hierarchy
methods.description: Initializes the hierarchy structure in the DOM.

methods.name: render_root_nodes
methods.description: Fetches and renders root nodes for the hierarchy.

methods.name: expand_node
methods.description: Expands a node to show its children and updates connectors.

methods.name: collapse_node
methods.description: Collapses a node, hiding its children and updating the hierarchy view.

methods.name: show_active_path
methods.description: Highlights the active path in the hierarchy.

methods.name: load_children
methods.description: Loads and renders child nodes for a given node.

methods.name: get_child_nodes
methods.description: Retrieves child nodes via server call.

methods.name: render_child_nodes
methods.description: Renders child nodes under a parent node.

methods.name: add_node
methods.description: Creates a new node instance and adds it to the hierarchy.

methods.name: add_connector
methods.description: Adds an SVG connector between parent and child nodes.

methods.name: get_connector_for_active_node
methods.description: Calculates SVG path for connector from active parent to child.

methods.name: get_connector_for_collapsed_node
methods.description: Calculates SVG path for connector from collapsed parent to child.

methods.name: set_path_attributes
methods.description: Sets SVG path attributes based on node classes.

methods.name: set_selected_node
methods.description: Marks a node as selected and updates classes.

methods.name: setup_node_click_action
methods.description: Attaches click event to nodes for hierarchy interaction.

methods.name: setup_edit_node_action
methods.description: Attaches edit button click to navigate to node form.

methods.name: setup_node_group_action
methods.description: Handles click events on node groups for expanding sibling nodes.

methods.name: add_node_to_hierarchy
methods.description: Adds a node element to the hierarchy DOM.

methods.name: get_node_group
methods.description: Creates a group of avatar icons representing multiple nodes.

methods.name: get_avatar
methods.description: Returns HTML for a node avatar.

methods.name: expand_sibling_group_node
methods.description: Expands a node's siblings and updates hierarchy.

methods.name: reattach_and_expand_node
methods.description: Reattaches a node to hierarchy and expands it.

methods.name: remove_levels_after_node
methods.description: Removes hierarchy levels after a specific node.

methods.name: remove_orphaned_connectors
methods.description: Removes SVG connectors that no longer have valid nodes.

methods.name: refresh_connectors
methods.description: Updates connectors between nodes.
